meta.title: Cottage Aesthetics — Nurse-led aesthetics in Hartlebury
meta.description: A calm countryside retreat for natural, nurse-led medical aesthetics in Hartlebury, Worcestershire.

hero.title: Cottage Aesthetics
hero.tag: Natural, considered aesthetics — in a calm countryside retreat where you're never rushed.

welcome.title: More like walking into a beautiful cottage than a busy clinic
welcome.body: Cottage Aesthetics is a nurse-led medical aesthetics clinic in the peaceful village of Hartlebury. Created to feel different — warm, unhurried and genuinely personal — it pairs exceptional clinical standards with a calm, welcoming space our regulars simply call “The Cottage.”

about.title: Hello, I'm Purdi
about.body1: I'm a registered nurse with over 15 years of NHS and private healthcare experience, and the founder of Cottage Aesthetics. My background in plastic surgery, dermatology and reconstructive services taught me that every face is unique — and that the best results come from understanding the individual in front of me.
about.body2: I believe great care is about more than the treatment itself: trust, honesty and safety are at the heart of every appointment. My goal is simply to help you look and feel like the best version of yourself — never changing who you are, just enhancing what makes you you.

card1.title: Longer Appointments
card1.body: Time to talk, assess and treat properly — never a conveyor belt.

card2.title: Honest Consultations
card2.body: Clear, evidence-based advice. Only what's right for you.

card3.title: Natural Results
card3.body: Subtle, balanced enhancements that still look like you.

card4.title: Medical Safety
card4.body: Nurse-led care, premium products, ongoing professional training.

quote1.text: “The loveliest experience — she made me feel completely relaxed and at ease.”

cards.title: Free Consultation
cards.body: A relaxed, no-pressure chat so you feel completely confident in your treatment and your practitioner.

cards.title: Microneedling
cards.body: Stimulates natural collagen to improve texture, soften fine lines and brighten the skin. Standard & advanced options.

cards.title: Skin Boosters
cards.body: Profhilo & Jalupro — deep hydration, firmness and a subtle “5-point facelift” glow from within.

cards.title: Polynucleotides
cards.body: Encourages the skin's natural repair — for face, under-eyes, neck, hands and décolletage.

cards.title: Dermal Fillers
cards.body: Lips, cheeks, chin and jawline — restoring volume and harmony while keeping everything natural.

cards.title: Wrinkle Relaxing
cards.body: Anti-wrinkle & prescription treatments require a face-to-face prescriber consultation for suitability.

cottage.title: A private retreat, tucked away from the high street
cottage.body: Limewashed walls, olive trees, oak and antique brass — every detail is designed so you relax the moment you arrive. A calm, Mediterranean-inspired space in the Worcestershire countryside.

quote2.text: “I felt truly listened to for the first time in my Botox journey — incredibly warm, welcoming and knowledgeable.”

ctaBox.title: Book your free consultation
ctaBox.body: Every journey begins with a relaxed, no-obligation chat. Booking takes less than a minute.
